title: Watch live: Swiss officials brief media after deadly NYE fire in Cras-Montana bar
summary: Swiss authorities are giving a press conference one day after a deadly fire broke out on New Year’s Eve in a bar at the Crans-Montana ski resort, killing some 40 people and injuring more than 115. Click on the video player to watch live.
contentText: Swiss officials told a press conference on Friday that the deadly fire at a Crans-Montana ski resort bar on New Year’s Eve, which killed at least 40 people, was likely caused by sparkling flares atop Champagne bottles that came too close to the ceiling. Authorities said 113 of the 119 injured have been identified, including 14 French and 11 Italians.
